text:
alex: heads-up — found a weird path in BYOK onboarding where the keystore-proxy accepted a rewrap request with role=service:export. still triaging, tagging ops.

sam: can you paste the raw request headers + audit id? do we have evidence a CMK blob left the HSM?

alex: minimal logs so far. looks like a POST to /v1/keystore/rewrap?mode=export with X-Request-Role: service:export

alex: log snippet:
```
TS=2026-02-12T15:04:02Z audit_id=ai-8f3c
method=POST path=/v1/keystore/rewrap?mode=export hdr_role=service:export user=svc-byo-onboard proxy=keystore-proxy-3
result=403_x_policy_denied
```

mei: 403_x_policy_denied is good — means HSM didn't sign/export. still treat as potential vuln though. 2 quick asks: (1) confirm proxy RBAC mapping table, (2) check KMS attestation logs for any rewrap/unwrap ops around that audit_id.

jordan: triage checklist (short): contain (block path), collect (full audit stream + network egress), assess (which customers touched), remediate (patch RBAC + rotate ephemeral creds), notify if required. @irina will advise on notification cadence.

irina: if keys were actually exported we'd need immediate customer notification per most BYOK contracts + legal loop. since logs show 403, start with an Incident Notice to affected customers saying ‘attempted-but-blocked’ and include evidence. keep SOC2/RoC packs updated with the audit bundle.

sam: immediate mitigation plan:
- add a deny rule in proxy for any role with suffix ":export"
- add conditional IAM deny at KMS layer: deny kms:Rewrap if request.attribute.role contains "export"
- deploy a temporary rate-limit + WAF rule on /keystore/rewrap

sam: example policy (pseudo):
```
allow {
  effect = "deny"
  when request.path == "/v1/keystore/rewrap" && contains(request.headers["X-Request-Role"], ":export")
}
```

alex: ran quick grep across onboarding logs: 3 attempts from svc-byo-onboard in last 24h, all 403. no egress records to external S3 endpoints. still need HSM attestation check.

deploy-bot: deploy queued — patch/rbac-block-export v1.0.1 -> staging (deploy_id=dep-4422)

jordan: forensics to run (assign):
- collect KMS audit logs (sam)
- pull HSM attestation & operator console logs (alex)
- network egress + NAT gateway logs (sam)
- container/image provenance for proxy (mei)
- review recent RBAC changes and PRs touching keystore-proxy (jordan)

irina: prepare customer template: brief incident summary, actions taken, raw audit id bundle, timeline, next steps, contact. keep it factual: "attempt blocked, no evidence of export; logs attached" unless forensics shows otherwise.

mei: also recommend hardening: require mTLS + client cert CN to include customer-keystore-id for any rewrap/export flows, and add attestation verification step in proxy (HSM-signed nonce).

sam: I’ll push the deny rule and firewall rule now, open PR #3456 and link runbook. rolling to prod after quick canary.

alex: thanks — action items:
- sam: patch + logs (PR #3456)
- mei: attestation+cert plan
- jordan: runbook + triage ownership
- irina: customer template

alex: will update thread after attestation results and prod canary. appreciate the quick responses :thumbsup:
